page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, maintaining a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent execution performance.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and external services. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

Because the ecs.g5ne.16xlarge relies on dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading, it offers highly predictable compute performance, though this resource density typically commands a higher qualitative cost profile compared to shared-core or hyperthreaded alternatives. The lack of bundled local storage is a key tradeoff, requiring architectural planning for external storage volumes. This server is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and database workloads that demand dedicated CPU resources and high network throughput.
